name: Coron, Palawan
description: Home to crystal-clear Kayangan Lake, stunning limestone cliffs, and some of the Philippines' best dive sites. Known for its rich marine biodiversity and WWII shipwrecks.

name: Boracay Island
description: Four kilometers of powdery white sand beach, turquoise waters, and vibrant nightlife. Multiple international awards for best beach destination.

name: Chocolate Hills, Bohol
description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site candidate featuring over 1,200 perfectly-shaped chocolate-brown hills spread across 50 square kilometers. Also home to the Philippine tarsier.

name: Sagada, Mountain Province
description: A cool mountain town famous for its hanging coffins, limestone caves, pine forests, and breathtaking terraced rice fields. A haven for trekkers and nature lovers.

name: Siargao Island
tagline: The surfing capital of the Philippines
description: A tear-shaped island in the Philippine Sea known for its world-class Cloud 9 surf break, crystal lagoons, rock pools, and white-sand sandbars.

name: Intramuros, Manila
tagline: The Walled City — history lives here
description: The 16th-century walled city and the historic center of Manila. Home to Fort Santiago, San Agustin Church (a UNESCO World Heritage Site), and Rizal Park.

name: Batanes Islands
tagline: Where the Pacific meets the South China Sea
description: The northernmost province of the Philippines, known for its Ivatan stone houses, rolling hills, lighthouses, and dramatic seascapes. Often called the most beautiful province.

name: Vigan, Ilocos Sur
description: One of the few Hispanic colonial towns in Asia that has retained its original structure. Cobblestone streets, Ancestral houses, and the iconic Bantay Church Bell Tower.
